capabilities: Index Bible references and related notes in an auto-updating index note
Import TXT, Markdown, and Google Docs files from a public Google Drive folder link
Convert written Bible references in note bodies into internal and Bible app links
Create manual index notes with an indice-biblico code block
Search note content with context snippets per result
extras: README is written in Portuguese. The plugin explicitly states it does not depend on Dataview or Meta Bind, does not require an API key or login for Google Drive import, and warns that the Drive import depends on Google's public page and may break if Google changes it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to index Bible references across notes or import transcriptions from public Google Drive folders into local Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Importação recursiva de arquivos TXT, Markdown e Documentos Google por um link público de pasta do Google Drive, sem API e sem login.

summary: Bible reference index plugin that builds an index of scripture references across notes and imports talk transcriptions from public Google Drive folders.
